title: The Resume Format Recruiters Actually Read
description:
If your resume isn’t getting interviews, it’s probably not being read. In this video, I break down the resume format recruiters actually read—and what needs to be visible in the first 6 seconds.

Recruiters scan resumes fast. If they can’t immediately understand what you do, you’re getting skipped. Learn how to structure your resume so it’s clear, easy to scan, and actually gets attention.

I’ll show you exactly what to include at the top of your resume:
 Headline
 Summary
 Core skills
 Experience (in the right order)

Because your resume isn’t a list—it’s a fast sales pitch.

I’m Kate Kirchner, career strategist and your career bestie. I help job seekers fix their resumes so they get interviews—not ignored.

 Watch the full video for a complete resume breakdown and step-by-step fixes. https://youtu.be/xe2hxq3F1L4
